note: Pending means NOT verified. Each acceptance requires real Windows evidence and reviewer confirmation. Never infer acceptance from CI or previews.

gates.description: Enable-disable-enable a disposable startup item on real Windows.
Verify representative Apps, Duplicates and Storage behavior on a disposable Windows test fixture.
Measure foreground/idle monitor overhead and unavailable sensors on Windows.
Verify production HTTPS gateway and signed challenge on a real provisioned Windows device.
Install the signed NSIS package on a clean Windows device.
Verify signed upgrade retains local state, operation history and Windows CNG device identity.
Verify representative trusted WinGet update launch and results.
Verify installed-driver inventory and Windows Optional Updates handoff.
Verify high-load evidence is surfaced and idle Windows does not create false warnings.
